-- Gameplay assertions use the UI READ bridge for UI-only native getters.
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local H={}
function H.Unit(unit)
 local snapshot=A.SnapshotUnit(unit);snapshot.Owner=unit:GetOwner();return snapshot
end
function H.Identity(current,original)
 for _,key in ipairs({'Index','GreatWorkType','ObjectType','Name','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do
  assert(current[key]==original[key],'original provenance changed: '..key)
 end
 assert(A.Rules.Equal(current.Effects,original.Effects),'original Effects changed')
end
function H.At(slot,original)
 local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(original.Index)
 assert(#found==1,'original index must occupy exactly one world slot: '..#found)
 local current=found[1]
 assert(current.Owner==slot.Owner and current.CityID==(slot.City or slot.CityID)
  and current.X==slot.X and current.Y==slot.Y and current.Building==slot.Building
  and current.Slot==slot.Slot,'original is not in the exact reserved owner/city/building/slot')
 H.Identity(current,original)
 return current
end
function H.Empty(slot)
 local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(slot.X,slot.Y))
 assert(city:GetOwner()==slot.Owner,'empty slot city owner changed')
 if slot.City or slot.CityID then assert(city:GetID()==(slot.City or slot.CityID),'empty reserved slot city ID changed') end
 local definition=assert(GameInfo.Buildings[slot.Building])
 assert(A.CityAssets(city)[definition.BuildingType].Works[slot.Slot]==-1,'source or reserved slot is not empty')
end
function H.City(city,index)
 local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
 local assets=A.CityAssets(city)
 for _,building in pairs(assets) do for slot,work in pairs(building.Works or {}) do
  if work==index then building.Works[slot]=-1 end
 end end
 local units={}
 local owners=PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()
 local free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()
 local seen={}
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do seen[owner]=true end
 if free and free>=0 and not seen[free] then owners[#owners+1]=free end
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if Players[owner] then for _,u in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if u:GetX()==city:GetX() and u:GetY()==city:GetY() then units[#units+1]=H.Unit(u) end
 end end end
 table.sort(units,function(a,b) if a.Owner~=b.Owner then return a.Owner<b.Owner end return a.ID<b.ID end)
 return {Owner=city:GetOwner(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Name=city:GetName(),
  Population=city:GetPopulation(),Assets=assets,Loyalty=A.CityLoyalty(city),
  Religion=reads.ReadCity(city:GetOwner(),city:GetID(),'RELIGIONS'),
  Faith=A.Rules.Copy(city:GetProperty(A.Rules.CITY_FAITH_KEY)),
  Governance=A.Rules.Copy(city:GetProperty(A.Rules.GOVERNANCE_KEY)),
  PurchasedPlots=reads.ReadCarrierPlots(city:GetOwner(),city:GetID()),UnitsOnCenter=units}
end
function H.Restored(before,index)
 local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(before.X,before.Y))
 local now=H.City(city,index)
if not A.Rules.Equal(now,before) then
 for key,value in pairs(before) do
  if not A.Rules.Equal(now[key],value) then
   print('[JAC_TYPE_CITY_DIFF] owner='..before.Owner..' x='..before.X..' y='..before.Y..' field='..key..' before='..A.Canonical(value)..' after='..A.Canonical(now[key]))
  end
 end
end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(now,before),'borrow city assets/plots/center units/governance were not restored')
end
function H.ClearCenters(cities)
 local forbidden,protected={},{}
 local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
 for _,t in ipairs(cities) do
  local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.X,t.Y))
  -- The human recovery destination stays human-owned. FROM_FREE borrows the Free city only.
  -- Source, Free and Third cities can change owner; all of their purchased plots stay excluded.
  if t.Role~='Human' then
   local plots=reads.ReadCarrierPlots(city:GetOwner(),city:GetID())
   for _,index in ipairs(plots) do forbidden[index]=true end
   protected[#protected+1]={Role=t.Role or 'Source',Owner=city:GetOwner(),City=city:GetID(),
    X=t.X,Y=t.Y,Plots=A.Rules.Copy(plots)}
  end
 end
 local owners=PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()
 local free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()
 local seen={}
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do seen[owner]=true end
 if free and free>=0 and not seen[free] then owners[#owners+1]=free end
 local function occupied(x,y)
  for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if Players[owner] then for _,unit in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if unit:GetX()==x and unit:GetY()==y then return true end
  end end end
  return false
 end
 local moved={}
 for _,t in ipairs(cities) do
  local blockers={}
  for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if Players[owner] then for _,unit in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if unit:GetX()==t.X and unit:GetY()==t.Y then blockers[#blockers+1]=unit end
  end end end
  table.sort(blockers,function(a,b) if a:GetOwner()~=b:GetOwner() then return a:GetOwner()<b:GetOwner() end return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
  for _,unit in ipairs(blockers) do
   local original=H.Unit(unit)
   local domain=GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].Domain or 'DOMAIN_LAND'
   local diagnostic={Owner=original.Owner,Unit=original.ID,Type=original.Type,Domain=domain,
    Center={X=t.X,Y=t.Y,Role=t.Role or 'Source'},ProtectedCities=A.Rules.Copy(protected),
    Owned=0,Forbidden=0,CityCenters=0,Impassable=0,WrongDomain=0,Occupied=0,Candidates={}}
   for index=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index)
    if q and q:GetOwner()==original.Owner then
     diagnostic.Owned=diagnostic.Owned+1
     if forbidden[index] then diagnostic.Forbidden=diagnostic.Forbidden+1
     elseif q:IsCity() then diagnostic.CityCenters=diagnostic.CityCenters+1
     elseif q:IsMountain() or q:IsImpassable() then diagnostic.Impassable=diagnostic.Impassable+1
     elseif (domain=='DOMAIN_SEA' and not q:IsWater()) or (domain~='DOMAIN_SEA' and q:IsWater()) then
      diagnostic.WrongDomain=diagnostic.WrongDomain+1
     elseif occupied(q:GetX(),q:GetY()) then diagnostic.Occupied=diagnostic.Occupied+1
     else diagnostic.Candidates[#diagnostic.Candidates+1]={Plot=index,X=q:GetX(),Y=q:GetY()} end
    end
   end
   diagnostic.CandidateCount=#diagnostic.Candidates
   print('[JAC_TYPE_GUARD_CANDIDATES] '..A.Canonical(diagnostic))
   local placed=false
   for _,candidate in ipairs(diagnostic.Candidates) do if not placed then
    local q=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(candidate.Plot))
    assert(q:GetOwner()==original.Owner and not forbidden[candidate.Plot] and not occupied(candidate.X,candidate.Y),
     'safe guard destination changed before placement')
    UnitManager.PlaceUnit(unit,candidate.X,candidate.Y)
    if unit:GetX()==candidate.X and unit:GetY()==candidate.Y then
     unit:SetDamage(original.Damage)
     unit:ChangeMovesRemaining(original.Moves-unit:GetMovesRemaining())
     original.X,original.Y=candidate.X,candidate.Y
     local after=H.Unit(unit)
     if not A.Rules.Equal(after,original) then
      print('[JAC_TYPE_GUARD_DIFFERENCE] '..A.Canonical({Before=original,After=after}))
     end
     assert(A.Rules.Equal(after,original),'fixture guard identity or abilities changed')
     moved[#moved+1]=original;placed=true
    end
   end end
   assert(placed,'no safe empty owned plot for original center guard: owner='..original.Owner
    ..' unit='..original.ID..' owned='..diagnostic.Owned..' forbidden='..diagnostic.Forbidden
    ..' centers='..diagnostic.CityCenters..' occupied='..diagnostic.Occupied..' candidates='..diagnostic.CandidateCount)
  end
  assert(not occupied(t.X,t.Y),'fixture city center remains occupied')
 end
 return moved
end
function H.Guards(records)

function H.ClearCenters(cities)
 local forbidden,protected={},{}
 local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
 for _,t in ipairs(cities) do
  local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.X,t.Y))
  -- The human recovery destination stays human-owned. FROM_FREE borrows the Free city only.
  -- Source, Free and Third cities can change owner; all of their purchased plots stay excluded.
  if t.Role~='Human' then
   local plots=reads.ReadCarrierPlots(city:GetOwner(),city:GetID())
   for _,index in ipairs(plots) do forbidden[index]=true end
   protected[#protected+1]={Role=t.Role or 'Source',Owner=city:GetOwner(),City=city:GetID(),
    X=t.X,Y=t.Y,Plots=A.Rules.Copy(plots)}
  end
 end
 local owners=PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()
 local free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()
 local seen={}
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do seen[owner]=true end
 if free and free>=0 and not seen[free] then owners[#owners+1]=free end
 local function occupied(x,y)
  for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if Players[owner] then for _,unit in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if unit:GetX()==x and unit:GetY()==y then return true end
  end end end
  return false
 end
 local moved={}
 for _,t in ipairs(cities) do
  local blockers={}
  for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do if Players[owner] then for _,unit in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
   if unit:GetX()==t.X and unit:GetY()==t.Y then blockers[#blockers+1]=unit end
  end end end
  table.sort(blockers,function(a,b) if a:GetOwner()~=b:GetOwner() then return a:GetOwner()<b:GetOwner() end return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
  for _,unit in ipairs(blockers) do
   local original=H.Unit(unit)
   local domain=GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].Domain or 'DOMAIN_LAND'
   local diagnostic={Owner=original.Owner,Unit=original.ID,Type=original.Type,Domain=domain,
    Center={X=t.X,Y=t.Y,Role=t.Role or 'Source'},ProtectedCities=A.Rules.Copy(protected),
    Owned=0,Forbidden=0,CityCenters=0,Impassable=0,WrongDomain=0,Occupied=0,Candidates={}}
   for index=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index)
    if q and q:GetOwner()==original.Owner then
     diagnostic.Owned=diagnostic.Owned+1
     if forbidden[index] then diagnostic.Forbidden=diagnostic.Forbidden+1
     elseif q:IsCity() then diagnostic.CityCenters=diagnostic.CityCenters+1
     elseif q:IsMountain() or q:IsImpassable() then diagnostic.Impassable=diagnostic.Impassable+1
     elseif (domain=='DOMAIN_SEA' and not q:IsWater()) or (domain~='DOMAIN_SEA' and q:IsWater()) then
      diagnostic.WrongDomain=diagnostic.WrongDomain+1
     elseif occupied(q:GetX(),q:GetY()) then diagnostic.Occupied=diagnostic.Occupied+1
     else diagnostic.Candidates[#diagnostic.Candidates+1]={Plot=index,X=q:GetX(),Y=q:GetY()} end
    end
   end
   diagnostic.CandidateCount=#diagnostic.Candidates
   print('[JAC_TYPE_GUARD_CANDIDATES] '..A.Canonical(diagnostic))
   local placed=false
   for _,candidate in ipairs(diagnostic.Candidates) do if not placed then
    local q=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(candidate.Plot))
    assert(q:GetOwner()==original.Owner and not forbidden[candidate.Plot] and not occupied(candidate.X,candidate.Y),
     'safe guard destination changed before placement')
    UnitManager.PlaceUnit(unit,candidate.X,candidate.Y)
    if unit:GetX()==candidate.X and unit:GetY()==candidate.Y then
     unit:SetDamage(original.Damage)
     unit:ChangeMovesRemaining(original.Moves-unit:GetMovesRemaining())
     original.X,original.Y=candidate.X,candidate.Y
     local after=H.Unit(unit)
     if not A.Rules.Equal(after,original) then
      print('[JAC_TYPE_GUARD_DIFFERENCE] '..A.Canonical({Before=original,After=after}))
     end
     assert(A.Rules.Equal(after,original),'fixture guard identity or abilities changed')
     moved[#moved+1]=original;placed=true
    end
   end end
   assert(placed,'no safe empty owned plot for original center guard: owner='..original.Owner
    ..' unit='..original.ID..' owned='..diagnostic.Owned..' forbidden='..diagnostic.Forbidden
    ..' centers='..diagnostic.CityCenters..' occupied='..diagnostic.Occupied..' candidates='..diagnostic.CandidateCount)
  end
  assert(not occupied(t.X,t.Y),'fixture city center remains occupied')
 end
 return moved
end

end
